title: Non-negative Matrix Factorisation with Topological Regularisation
summary: Non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) learns additive representations from data, but non-negativity alone does not ensure interpretable basis functions. We introduce Top-NMF, which guides basis learning through general topological preferences without prescribing the detailed form of the components. Observations and basis vectors are treated as non-negative functions on structured domains. Discrete topological conditions are difficult to optimise directly.
